description: Full Tetris — all 7 tetrominoes, rotation, line clears, levels, next-piece preview, keyboard and touch controls.

faqs.a: Arrow keys: ←/→ move, ↓ soft drop, ↑ rotate, Space hard drop, P pause. Touch buttons are on screen too.
Every 10 lines raises the level, speeding up the fall and multiplying line-clear points.
Single 40, Double 100, Triple 300, Tetris 1200 — each multiplied by the current level.
When a new piece has no room to spawn, the game ends and shows your final score.

howto: Use ← → to move, ↑ to rotate, ↓ to drop faster.
Clear lines — 4 at once (Tetris) scores big.
Every 10 lines the level (and speed) rises.
Don't let the stack reach the top!
title: Tetris Game
